_why: ui.statamic-cms-package reads a package.json as meaning a Control Panel Vite build, and asks
for @statamic/cms in devDependencies so the UI kit is pinned to the Statamic version in vendor/.
This addon has no Control Panel surface at all. It renders one frontend tag, ships a hand-written
stylesheet and script with no build step, and imports nothing from @statamic/cms/ui. The
package.json exists for exactly one dependency: playwright-core, which drives tests/browser/run.mjs
for the behaviour that only exists in a browser — double-click to edit, the dirty count, Escape
reverting, the shape of the save request, and the bar surviving a hostile host stylesheet. Adding
the dependency would pull in a UI kit nothing imports.
Revisit this the day the addon grows a real CP screen — then the rule is right and this entry is
release.editions is an INFO, not a rule, and it asks a question rather than reporting a fault:
"Confirm this is a single-edition commercial addon." Confirmed on 2026-09-19 — one product, no
Core/Pro split, sold inside the suite. The field stays absent because the linter is right that a
declared edition without a feature behind it cannot gate anything.
